# superset_database_related_objects (Data Source)

Lists the charts whose datasets use a database connection and the dashboards those charts are placed on, for example to check what depends on a connection before replacing it. The lookup fails when the connection does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything that depends on the warehouse connection, for example to check before replacing it.
data "superset_database_related_objects" "warehouse" {
  database_name = "Warehouse"
}

output "warehouse_chart_ids" {
  value = data.superset_database_related_objects.warehouse.chart_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the connection, looked up from `database_name` when that is set.
- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection. Exactly one of `database_name` and `database_id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `chart_ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the charts.
- `charts` (Attributes List) The charts, in the order Superset lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--charts))
- `dashboard_ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the dashboards.
- `dashboards` (Attributes List) The dashboards with at least one of the charts, in the order Superset lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboards))

<a id="nestedatt--charts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `charts`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the chart.
- `name` (String) Name of the chart.
- `viz_type` (String) Visualization type of the chart.


<a id="nestedatt--dashboards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dashboards`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dashboard.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the dashboard; null when it has none.
- `title` (String) Title of the dashboard.
